title: Module 25 — Observability
description: Stand up a real Prometheus: run a target that exposes /metrics, write a scrape config, start Prometheus, and query it over the HTTP API. Then meet the absent-metric trap and reason about a lawful alert. All work is scoped to a throwaway ~/obs-lab.
